nodes.label: Real-time safe read() via GetPrimitiveArrayCritical
nodes.rationale: Pins the Java array and lets the lock-free jitter buffer fill it directly: no copy, lock, allocation or syscall; sendto() never called inside a critical region.

nodes.label: Security: every datagram is hostile
nodes.rationale: VBAN has no authentication and source addresses can be forged; audit found no memory corruption but 9 abuse issues; remaining limits need an AEAD secure mode, so keep VBAN on trusted networks or a VPN.

nodes.label: Playout-deadline jitter buffer (ADR-001)
nodes.rationale: Packets placed by frame counter so reordered packets and late redundant copies fill holes before playout; concealment at playout time distinguishes loss (clock keeps running) from starvation (playout holds), avoiding silence + re-prime.

nodes.label: Redundant copies loss protection (vban_tx_set_redundancy)
nodes.rationale: Time-diversity copies n packets later (~5 ms) cut audible loss 79-91% with no latency cost at 2x bandwidth; byte-identical so normal receivers see a normal stream; only enabled for SDK receivers since Voicemeeter duplicate handling is unverified.

nodes.label: XOR parity FEC (rejected)
nodes.rationale: Repaired only 20% on Wi-Fi because burst losses take out two packets per group, and would need a non-standard packet type, so not adopted.

nodes.label: Two-atomic usage guard for close()
nodes.rationale: close() may race read()/write() from any thread; guard waits for the in-flight call and later calls return 0, preventing use-after-free.

nodes.rationale: work_mutex held by clock thread and taken by .sync_stop so hw_free/close never race an in-flight copy or period_elapsed(); sendmsg only called with no spinlock held.

nodes.label: Interpretations where the spec is silent or ambiguous
nodes.norm_label: interpretations where the spec is silent or ambiguous
nodes.rationale: Choices follow reference implementations in the wild (thib3113/vban, vban-cmd, VBAN-Key, Voicemeeter); parsing is lenient by default, VBAN_PARSE_STRICT for conformance; little-endian encoded byte-by-byte.

nodes.label: No fast-math / -fno-trapping-math float policy
nodes.rationale: MSVC keeps /fp:precise because fast-math folds v == v to true and lets hostile NaN samples past the float sanitizer in vban_pcm.c; GCC/Clang get -fno-math-errno -fno-trapping-math so the float clamp loop vectorizes.

nodes.label: Optimization log (measure, change one thing, re-measure)
nodes.norm_label: optimization log (measure, change one thing, re-measure)
nodes.rationale: -fno-trapping-math enabled vectorization of f32->s16 clamp; non-vectorizable paths kept lrintf; microsecond waits cut vban_recv CPU 12.7%->4.1%; adaptive target floored at pull+packet size; SEC-005 sanitizer done as integer clamp in noinline restrict helper.

nodes.label: Capture idle re-anchoring
nodes.rationale: Packets counted but not buffered while nobody captures; each capture start re-anchors to the live stream so it never starts from stale audio (fixes the stale capture timeline bug).
